title: Presheaf extension by zero on a localized site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $W$ an object [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For a presheaf $F$ of abelian groups on the slice category $\mathcal C/W$, define the presheaf $j_{W,p!}F$ on $\mathcal C$ by

$$
(j_{W,p!}F)(V)=\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\operatorname{Mor}_{\mathcal C}(V,W)}F(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}W).
$$

The summand indexed by $\varphi$ is the value of $F$ at the corresponding slice object. For a morphism $g:V'\to V$, restriction sends the summand indexed by $\varphi$ to the summand indexed by $\varphi\circ g$ using the restriction map of $F$. A morphism of presheaves is sent to the direct sum of its component maps. If $\mathcal C$ is a site, give $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology: a family of maps over $W$ covers when its underlying family covers in $\mathcal C$. For a sheaf $F$ on this localized site, the extension-by-zero sheaf $j_{W!}F$ is the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $j_{W,p!}F$ for the given topology on $\mathcal C$. *Relation to the ringed-site version:* when $F$ is a sheaf of abelian groups on $\mathcal C/W$, regarded as a module over the constant sheaf of rings $\mathbb Z$ restricted to $\mathcal C/W$, the presheaf $j_{W,p!}F$ is the underlying abelian presheaf of the extension-by-zero presheaf $P_F$ of [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] for $\mathcal O=\mathbb Z$ and $U=W$; the present node only additionally allows $F$ to be a presheaf.
